How do we drain a queue?

Original question

Can an interrupted worker resume its pending jobs?

First reply

Keep a durable journal before acknowledging a job.

await journal.append(job);
await acknowledge(job);
Noise post tools

Follow-up from the author

The restart recovered every pending job in order.

  • Stop before commit
  • Restart and compare the journal
